answer: Trust spreads like a tide from a few vetted seed agents through short random walks on the endorsement graph (SybilRank style). Sybils sit on a terrace reached only by the few attack edges an attacker can get honest agents to sign. With g such edges, a cluster of any size collects trust worth about g honest nodes, so 1,000 fakes behind 3 edges earn what 3 real agents do. Each extra edge means bribing or fooling a real agent, which pushes the payoff past any profitable horizon.
